summary.description: Cyanides are chemical compounds commonly found combined with hydrogen, sodium, or potassium. Hydrogen cyanide is a colorless gas with an almond odour, while sodium and potassium cyanide are white solids with similar odour.
emission_sources: Industrial processes including chemical, plastic, rubber, explosives manufacturing
environmental_impact: Toxic to humans and animals by ingestion, skin contact, and inhalation, especially during industrial exposure or accidental spills
Not persistent in water or soil due to rapid microbial breakdown and evaporation
Potential to leach into groundwater due to low soil binding capacity
No significant global environmental accumulation or bioaccumulation

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Cyanides are highly toxic to humans, causing serious health risks via inhalation, ingestion, or skin contact, particularly in industrial accidents or spills.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: Due to their potential to leach into groundwater and toxicity in water, cyanides pose a threat to clean water resources and sanitation.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: The industrial use and accidental release of cyanides highlight the importance of managing hazardous substances responsibly to reduce environmental and health risks.
